method_selection.why: Validation primary peaks at 0.601838 in epoch 8 and declines to 0.600686 by epoch 10 while training loss continues downward, indicating mild overfitting. On this small dataset, the appropriate first challenger is the existing rank-16 model with stronger regularization centered on AdamW weight decay 3e-4, without adding architectural capacity. A coherent dropout/L2/LR-decay schedule is literature-aligned and has measured about +0.0015 standalone; that gain is below epsilon but is an honest, low-cost isolation test with 11 iterations remaining.

rejected.reason: It has higher joint upside but immediately adds DCN capacity, BPR, and recency weighting, confounding the requested first test of regularization on the rank-16 parent.
Reducing to k=8 may regularize the model, but the explicit prior calls for retaining rank 16 and testing weight decay 3e-4 first.
Ensembling is a closing move; single-model regularization has not yet been tested and prior identical-config ensembling produced less than 0.0001.

expected_delta_basis: The selected regularization-schedule card and research/models-losses-hparams.md section 4 estimate roughly +0.002 to +0.008 for the coherent package, while the journal reports that isolated weaker regularization doses were flat.

hypothesis: Because validation peaks around epoch 8 and then falls, indicating overfit, rank-averaging three consecutive-seed replicas of the unchanged rank-16 FM will reduce initialization variance at lower cost than five members but is expected to improve validation primary by only about 0.0001.

method_selection.citation: D2Q duration debiasing, KDD 2022 (arXiv:2206.06003); KuaiRand research notes
method_selection.why: Validation reportedly peaks and then declines while training loss continues falling, indicating overfit. The excluded-family constraint rules out overfit and flat-signal cards, while duration-regime-heads remains eligible through metric-mismatch/data-shift/underfit. It is the strongest eligible standalone mechanism: duration is impression-known, the 18-second label regime creates distinct ranking behavior, and this method has a replicated benchmark gain of about +0.0014 with a card estimate up to +0.006. It is preferable to another small ensemble or a recency rider on the current weakly regularized parent.

rejected.reason: Eligible as data-shift treatment, but evidence says its gain appears reliably only on an accepted regularized ranker; the current champion is an ensemble of the baseline after the regularization package failed.
Its overfit family is explicitly excluded, and the prior coherent rank-16 regularization attempt with weight decay 3e-4 scored 0.6013 and was rejected.
The flat-signal family is excluded, and a three-seed baseline ensemble has already been tried; further same-configuration members have diminishing expected gain below the convergence threshold.

expected_delta_basis: The duration-regime-heads card cites D2Q duration debiasing (KDD 2022, arXiv:2206.06003), reports a replicated gain near +0.0014, and estimates +0.002 to +0.006 when duration bias is material.
